source_inventory.scope: Checked-in code and compiler-closure inventory only. No credentials, current/provider/model/account/private packets, policy cache, native invocation or spend evidence. Literal URLs may be dormant code; variable URLs and SDK calls can be absent.
required_before_shared_deploy: Review deterministic fallback of every changed adapter importer
Capture named native controls/schedules before code changes
Test transport denial with synthetic credentials and requests; never resolve real credentials
Verify complete importer closure, exact native packages/receipts and unchanged controls
Audit direct vendor/SDK calls separately; router denial alone cannot establish global no-paid enforcement

source_call_map.scope: Static named adapter call locations in checked-in engine sources only. Function bodies and prompt values are not emitted; no provider/current/private/account input. Dynamic calls and indirect shared helpers require separate review.

remaining: Run exact named native control baseline before shared adapter changes
Review whole-handler absent-model behavior in all affected packages
Complete adapter regression/integration suites without private data or provider requests
Deploy and verify exact complete native closures/receipts while preserving controls
Audit direct SDK/HTTP integrations outside shared adapters separately
